a2-01-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Arrived at the Hotel
a2-01-01.scenario: You and the group have just reached the hotel in Ninh Bình. Meg's sister Lauren asks what you have done today. You have travelled by train and you have arrived at the hotel.
a2-01-01.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have travelled by train today and that you have arrived at the hotel.
cues: Say how you have travelled today
a2-01-01.target: Hoy he viajado en tren y he llegado al hotel.
a2-01-01.english: Today I have travelled by train and I have arrived at the hotel.
a2-01-01.canDo: I can talk about a recent travel experience using regular pretérito perfecto forms.

a2-01-02.title: Communicative Challenge: This Afternoon
a2-01-02.scenario: It is the first afternoon in Ninh Bình. Daniela asks what you have done. You have seen the mountains and you have written a message to a friend.
a2-01-02.prompt: Tell Daniela that this afternoon you have seen the mountains and written a message.
a2-01-02.target: Esta tarde he visto las montañas y he escrito un mensaje.
a2-01-02.english: This afternoon I have seen the mountains and I have written a message.
a2-01-02.canDo: I can describe recent actions using common irregular past participles.

a2-01-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Questions at Dinner
a2-01-03.scenario: At dinner in Ninh Bình you sit next to Meg's sister Kaylee. You want to know if she has travelled by train and what she has done today.
a2-01-03.prompt: Ask Kaylee whether she has travelled by train and what she has done today.
cues: Ask if she has travelled by train
Ask what she has done today
a2-01-03.target: ¿Has viajado en tren? ¿Qué has hecho hoy?
a2-01-03.english: Have you travelled by train? What have you done today?
a2-01-03.canDo: I can ask and answer simple questions about recent experiences.

a2-01-04.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Reception
a2-01-04.scenario: You are Carlos at the small hotel in Ninh Bình. The receptionist asks whether you have booked a room. You have booked one and you have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.prompt: Tell the receptionist that you have booked a room and that you have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.target: Sí, he reservado una habitación. He llegado esta mañana.
a2-01-04.english: Yes, I have booked a room. I have arrived this morning.
a2-01-04.canDo: I can describe recent travel and accommodation experiences.

a2-01-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Walk
a2-01-05.scenario: In the evening in Ninh Bình, Meg asks what you and the others have seen on your walk. You have seen rivers and mountains and you have taken many photos.
a2-01-05.prompt: Tell Meg what you have seen and that you have taken many photos.
cues: Say what you have all seen
Say what you have done with the camera
a2-01-05.target: Hemos visto ríos y montañas. He hecho muchas fotos.
a2-01-05.english: We have seen rivers and mountains. I have taken many photos.
a2-01-05.canDo: I can describe what I have done during a recent arrival and trip.

a2-01-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Day
a2-01-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the first day in Ninh Bình, Meg phones from her room and asks about your day. You have travelled by train, you have arrived at the hotel, you have booked a room and you have seen the mountains.
a2-01-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have done today: your trip, the hotel and what you have seen.
cues: Say how you have travelled and where you have arrived
a2-01-consolidation.target: Hemos viajado en tren y hemos llegado al hotel. He reservado una habitación y he visto las montañas.
a2-01-consolidation.english: We have travelled by train and we have arrived at the hotel. I have booked a room and I have seen the mountains.
a2-01-consolidation.canDo: I can use the Unit 1 pretérito perfecto forms in simple travel contexts.
